title: Goa packing guide for women
description: What to pack for Goa: beach, day, night and shack looks for women at three budgets, with a packing list by trip length, brands and prices.
intro: Goa is relaxed. Nobody cares if you wear the same dress twice. Pack light, pack colour and pack shoes you can take off. Here are looks for beach, day and night, plus packing lists for three, five and seven days.

sections.heading: Understand the Goa mood
sections.body: North Goa is for beach shacks, parties and markets. South Goa is quieter, with long beaches and cafes. In both, loose, light and colourful rule. Fabric matters more than brand. Pick cotton, linen and viscose. Nobody dresses up for the beach. At night, a simple dress with sandals is enough.
tips: Day: shorts, sundress or kaftan with sandals.
Night: a slip dress, a co-ord or a crop top with a skirt.
Churches in Old Goa expect covered shoulders and knees.
Carry a light shawl for church visits and breezy evenings.

sections.heading: Outfit formulas
sections.body: Each includes footwear and one accessory.

looks.name: Beach day
pieces: Cotton kaftan or sundress, about ₹1,200 (Fabindia, H&M or Myntra)
looks.why: It goes from beach to shack to cafe without a change.

looks.name: Exploring day
pieces: Linen shirt in white or blue, about ₹1,800 (Uniqlo or Zara)
Cotton shorts or wide-leg trousers, about ₹1,500
looks.why: Light layers cool you in the sun.

looks.name: Night shack
pieces: Satin slip dress or a ruched mini, about ₹2,500 (Zara, Mango or Only)
Denim jacket for the sea breeze, about ₹2,500
Footwear: flat sandals or low wedges, about ₹1,500
looks.why: A short slip dress works at a shack or a club.

looks.name: Party night, statement
pieces: Co-ord set in sequin or silk, about ₹6,500 (Zara or AND)
Footwear: strappy heels you can take off, about ₹3,000
looks.why: The outfit that goes to the best party of the trip.

sections.heading: Packing list by trip length
sections.body: Three days: two sundresses, one kaftan, one co-ord, two swimsuits, one pair of shorts, sandals, slides. Five days: add a linen shirt, a second co-ord, one night dress and a light jacket. Seven days: add a skirt, a third swimsuit and a hat. Wear your heaviest items on the plane.
tips: Three days: seven or eight items, one small bag.
Five days: ten or eleven items, one cabin bag.
Seven days: twelve to fourteen items. Laundry is cheap in Goa.
Pack one sarong. It serves as a towel, a cover-up and a scarf.

sections.heading: Modesty and respect
sections.body: Goa is relaxed, but it still has limits. Beachwear belongs at the beach, so cover up with a sarong or a kaftan when you walk into town. Churches, such as the Basilica of Bom Jesus, ask for covered shoulders and knees. Temples ask you to remove shoes and cover the legs. In small villages, locals prefer modest clothes. You will also feel more comfortable, since sun and mosquitoes love bare legs at dusk. Carry a light scarf. It covers shoulders in a church, shields your neck from the sun, and keeps you warm on the scooter at night.
tips: Wear a cover-up on a scooter. Helmets are mandatory too.
Carry a light scarf in your bag.
Keep beachwear for the beach and the resort.
Mosquito repellent is a better accessory than another bracelet.

sections.heading: On the plane
sections.body: Wear loose trousers, a light shirt or tee, and sneakers or slip-ons. Tie a light shawl at the waist. You will land in humid heat, so avoid jeans.

sections.heading: Fabric guide
sections.body: Choose cotton, linen, viscose and rayon. These breathe. Avoid polyester in the heat. Avoid heavy denim and silk. Salt air is hard on delicate fabric.

sections.heading: Climate note
sections.body: The best weather is November to February. It is warm and dry. March to May is hot and humid. June to September is monsoon, with heavy rain and many closed shacks. Pack a rain jacket and quick-dry fabric in monsoon.

sections.heading: What to stop buying for Goa
sections.body: Stop buying white linen you cannot keep clean. Stop buying heavy heels. Stop buying a bag of outfits for photos only. Buy shoes you can walk in sand with, and one dress that you love.

faq.q: What should women wear in Goa?
faq.a: Wear sundresses, shorts, kaftans and sandals by day. At night, a slip dress or co-ord works well.

faq.q: Can I wear a bikini in Goa?
faq.a: Yes, on beaches and at resort pools. Cover up when you walk into town or visit a church.

faq.q: What should I wear to a church in Goa?
faq.a: Cover your shoulders and knees. A light shawl and a midi dress work well.

faq.q: How many outfits should I pack for five days?
faq.a: Ten or eleven items is enough. Mix and match, and re-wear the shorts and kaftan.

cta.headline: Pack colours that already work for you
cta.sub: One selfie, five questions: your season, your palette, your three strengths. Pack the right shades. Free.
